purpose: Basic Five evaluation in which low-rank adapters (LoRA) inside the attention projections of a frozen pretrained backbone are trained together with the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 task head, to measure how far a light, weight-updating adaptation moves each model beyond frozen probing.

provenance.written: 2026-11-19, after the runs, from the code and the run records
provenance.code: ${EXPERIMENT_ROOT}/code_v8 and code_v9 (b5x/lora.py, b5x/train.py, b5x/train_cls.py, b5x/train_det.py); code_v9 differs from code_v8 only in the DPT learning rate
provenance.note: The runs read their task definitions and optimizer blocks from BASIC5_{LINEAR,ATTENTIVE,FINETUNE}_v1.json and the LoRA constants from the code. This file documents those runs; it was not an input to them.

record_protocol_ids.B5X_LORA_LP_v2: ImageNet-1k, SSv2, ADE20K and NYUv2 (directory LORA_v2/seed{0,1,2})
record_protocol_ids.B5X_LORA_LP_v1: COCO (directory LORA/seed{0,1,2}); for COCO the v1 and v2 recipes are identical, see version_history
record_protocol_ids.excluded: B5X_LORA_LP_2EP_v2 is a 2-epoch resume test (RAEv2 ImageNet-1k) and is not a result

design_principle: Preserve the dataset, split, input geometry, epoch count, task head on the canonical feature, loss, and metric of BASIC5_FAIR_v1. Add rank-16 LoRA to every attention projection of every transformer block. Train the head with the BASIC5_ATTENTIVE_v1 optimizer block of the task and the LoRA matrices at the BASIC5_FINETUNE_v1 learning rate of the task.

global_rules.pretrained_weights: Use the released pretrained checkpoint as-is; no intermediate adaptation or task-specific pretraining.
global_rules.backbone_eval_mode: The backbone stays in eval() during training: dropout off, normalization statistics frozen, the DINOv3 RoPE training augmentation disabled.
global_rules.backbone_gradients: Gradients flow through the frozen backbone to the LoRA matrices; no backbone weight receives a gradient (checked on the first step of every run).
trainable_scope: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 task head on the canonical feature (COCO: the model's Unified feature pyramid plus the complete Faster R-CNN detector)
not_trainable: all original backbone weights, including the attention projections that carry LoRA
MLPs, patch embeddings, normalization affine parameters, positional embeddings
poolers, mergers, and any released head

lora.formula: W x + (alpha / r) * B A x
lora.initialization: A ~ Kaiming-uniform (a = sqrt(5)), B = 0, so training starts exactly at the released backbone
lora.targets: In every transformer block, every nn.Linear whose own name is qkv, proj, q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, or out_proj and whose module path contains 'attn' or 'attention'. A block must yield 2 (fused qkv + output) or 4 (separate q, k, v + output) targets, otherwise the run stops.
lora.block_lists: The model's transformer blocks; VGGT-Omega: both the frame and the global (inter-frame) attention blocks of its aggregator; RAEv2-K7: the 24 DINOv3-L blocks of the K=7 tokenizer.
lora.live_check: Before training, every wrapped projection must be called by the canonical feature path, and a random perturbation of B must change the canonical feature; otherwise the run stops.

feature_extraction.layer: The same canonical feature as the model's BASIC5_FAIR_v1 (Unified LP) run; LoRA changes the backbone that produces it, not the readout.
feature_extraction.spatial_tasks: ADE20K, NYUv2: the canonical spatial grid. COCO: the canonical spatial map fed to the model's own Unified feature pyramid.
feature_extraction.feature_cache: Forbidden because the features change during training.
feature_extraction.activation_checkpointing: Used on ImageNet-1k, SSv2, and COCO as a memory-only implementation detail.

lr_group_rules.head_lr: the BASIC5_ATTENTIVE_v1 base_lr of the task, linearly scaled to the effective batch
lr_group_rules.lora_lr: the BASIC5_FINETUNE_v1 base_lr of the task, linearly scaled to the effective batch; no layer decay
lr_group_rules.no_decay: 1-D parameters (biases, normalization affine) and parameters whose name contains 'norm'
lr_group_rules.schedule_unit: The learning rate advances once per optimizer step over epochs x steps_per_epoch steps; warm-up and cosine apply to each group's own base learning rate.

global_rules.hyperparameter_policy: One recipe per task, applied unchanged to all six models. No model-specific learning rate, rank, target set, or layer selection. The only per-model change is the shortened DINOv3-7B schedule on ImageNet-1k and SSv2 (see tasks.*.short_schedule).
global_rules.precision: bfloat16 backbone weights and bfloat16 autocast; LoRA and head parameters, loss, and metrics in float32.
global_rules.resume: Runs longer than one 12-hour job resume from the last epoch checkpoint (trainable weights, optimizer state, step counter, sampler epoch). Random number generators are reseeded per segment, so a resumed run differs from an uninterrupted one only in its random draws.

input.train: random resized crop to 224, scale [0.08, 1.0], ratio [0.75, 1.3333], bicubic, random horizontal flip p=0.5
input.evaluation: resize shorter side to 256 (bicubic), center crop 224, one view
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

imagenet1k.feature_and_pooling: The model's Unified LP global feature, L2-normalized.
imagenet1k.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 linear 1000-class classifier (weights N(0, 0.01), bias 0)
imagenet1k.trainable_scope: LoRA A/B and the linear classifier

optimization.distribution: 8 GPUs x 32 images, no gradient accumulation

short_schedule.rule: Everything else unchanged; the 5-epoch warm-up and the cosine decay span the 50 epochs.
short_schedule.reason: compute: about 98 hours per seed on one 8-GPU node at 100 epochs; three seeds had to finish before the main-paper deadline

imagenet1k.augmentation: Identical to the frozen-linear baseline; no Mixup, CutMix, label smoothing, RandAugment, or random erasing.

metrics.primary: top-1 accuracy on all 50,000 validation images

imagenet1k.minimal_deviation_note: The 100 epochs, input, canonical feature, and linear classifier stay fixed; LoRA is the only added capacity.

input.train: random horizontal flip p=0.5; resize shorter side to 800 while limiting longer side to 1333
input.evaluation: resize shorter side to 800 while limiting longer side to 1333
input.normalization: the model's Unified detection normalization, applied by the detector transform
input.annotations: crowd boxes and boxes of width or height <= 1 px dropped; labels 1..80

coco.feature_and_pooling: The canonical spatial map feeds the model's own Unified feature pyramid: basic5 SimpleFPN (transposed convolutions) for SigLIP 2-G, Cosmos 3 Super, and VGGT-Omega; the package SimpleFeaturePyramid (bilinear resampling + 1x1 laterals) for DINOv3-7B, RAEv2-K7, and V-JEPA 2.1. Both give 4 levels with 256 channels. Never globally pool.
coco.head: torchvision Faster R-CNN: RPN with anchors 32/64/128/256 x ratios {0.5, 1, 2}, MultiScaleRoIAlign 7x7 (sampling ratio 2), box classifier and regressor (num_classes 91, labels 1..80 used)
coco.trainable_scope: LoRA A/B, the feature pyramid, RPN, and RoI heads

optimization.lora_lr_note: The BASIC5_FINETUNE_v1 COCO learning rate equals the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 one, so LoRA and the detector share one learning rate.
optimization.schedule: step decay: x0.1 after epoch 8, x0.01 after epoch 11

coco.augmentation: Scale resize and horizontal flip only.
coco.loss: standard Faster R-CNN RPN and RoI classification/regression losses

metrics.primary: COCO bbox AP@[0.50:0.95] on all 5,000 val2017 images, final epoch

coco.minimal_deviation_note: Detector, pyramid, 1x schedule, SGD recipe, batch size, and augmentation are the model's Unified LP ones; LoRA is added and trains at the same rate.

input.train: random rescale by [0.5, 2.0] (bicubic, each side at least 224 px), random 224x224 crop, random horizontal flip p=0.5
input.evaluation: image resized to 224x224 (bicubic), label resized to 224x224 (nearest)
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

ade20k.feature_and_pooling: The canonical spatial grid (14x14 for patch-16 models; 7x7 for the Cosmos 3 Super merger), the unchanged 1x1 Conv, bilinear upsampling of the logits to the label size with align_corners=false.
ade20k.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 1x1 Conv with 150 outputs (weights N(0, 0.01), bias 0)
ade20k.augmentation: Same geometry as BASIC5_FAIR_v1; no photometric augmentation.

metrics.primary: mean IoU over 150 classes on the 2,000 validation images, final epoch

ade20k.minimal_deviation_note: Split, 20 epochs, feature, 1x1 head, upsampling, and metric stay fixed; LoRA is the only added capacity.

nyuv2.split: official Eigen-style 795 train / 654 test from labeled.mat and splits.mat

input.orientation: Images and depth maps read in their true 480x640 orientation (the basic5 loader transposed them).
input.train: image resized to 224x224 (bicubic), depth resized to 224x224 (bilinear), random horizontal flip p=0.5
input.evaluation: the same deterministic 224x224 resize without flip
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

nyuv2.feature_and_pooling: The canonical spatial grid, the unchanged 1x1 depth head, bilinear upsampling with align_corners=false.
nyuv2.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 single-channel 1x1 Conv, depth = softplus(x) + 1e-3
nyuv2.trainable_scope: LoRA A/B and the 1x1 depth head
nyuv2.loss: scale-invariant log-depth loss on valid pixels, lambda = 0.5: mean(d^2) - 0.5 * mean(d)^2 with d = log(pred) - log(gt)

metrics.evaluation_mask: valid pixels with 0.1 < depth < 10 m; predictions clamped to [0.1, 10]
metrics.primary_in_record: RMSE in meters after per-image median scale alignment (field rmse)
metrics.paper_metric: RMSE in meters without alignment (field rmse_unaligned), as defined in the paper's evaluation appendix

nyuv2.minimal_deviation_note: Split, mask and range, 30 epochs, 1x1 head, and loss stay fixed; LoRA is the only added capacity. The upright orientation is shared with the same-code LP control (B5X_LP_CONTROL_v1).

input.temporal_sampling: one frame from each of 16 equal temporal segments; random within the segment for training, segment center for evaluation
input.train: one random resized crop to 224 (scale [0.08, 1.0], ratio [0.75, 1.3333], bicubic) shared by all 16 frames; horizontal flip disabled
input.evaluation: resize shorter side to 256 (bicubic), center crop 224; one temporal clip and one spatial view
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization
input.loader: one decord loader for all six models; missing files are excluded at construction and counted; a decode failure stops the run instead of substituting an all-zero clip

ssv2.feature_and_pooling: The model's Unified LP SSv2 feature: DINOv3-7B and RAEv2-K7: per-frame L2-normalized global feature (DINOv3 CLS; RAEv2 mean of K7 tokens), then temporal mean; SigLIP 2-G and Cosmos 3 Super: per-frame pooled feature (MAP pooler; merger mean), then temporal mean, no L2; V-JEPA 2.1: mean of the spatiotemporal tokens of the 16-frame clip, L2-normalized; VGGT-Omega: aggregator over the 16 frames, mean of patch tokens, L2-normalized.
ssv2.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 linear 174-class classifier (weights N(0, 0.01), bias 0)
ssv2.trainable_scope: LoRA A/B and the linear classifier

optimization.distribution: 8 GPUs x 8 clips x 4 accumulation steps = effective batch 256

short_schedule.rule: Everything else unchanged; the 5-epoch warm-up and the cosine decay span the 24 epochs.
short_schedule.reason: compute: about 138 hours per seed on one 8-GPU node at 50 epochs; three seeds had to finish before the main-paper deadline

ssv2.augmentation: Same spatial and temporal policy as BASIC5_FAIR_v1; no Mixup, CutMix, RandAugment, random erasing, or horizontal flip.

metrics.primary: top-1 accuracy on all 24,777 validation videos, final epoch

ssv2.minimal_deviation_note: 16 frames, 50 epochs, the model's Unified LP video feature, and the classifier stay fixed; LoRA is the only added capacity.

vggt_omega.lora_targets: 48 aggregator blocks (24 frame + 24 global) x 2 projections = 96

reporting.checkpoint_rule: Use the final scheduled epoch; no selection on the reported validation/test split.
reporting.seed_aggregation: Report mean and sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) over seeds 0, 1, and 2; retain every per-seed result.
required_metadata: LoRA rank, alpha, number of wrapped projections, and live-check result
total, trainable, LoRA, and head parameter counts
epochs, effective batch, realized head and LoRA learning rates, steps per epoch, total steps
code sha256, PBS job id, host, GPU, torch and python versions
reporting.validity_rule: A cell counts only with COMPLETED_VALID.json, the recipe's epoch count reached, steps_per_epoch x epochs = total steps, and evaluation on the full split.
reporting.comparability_rule: Short-schedule cells (DINOv3-7B ImageNet-1k 50 epochs, SSv2 24 epochs) must be marked wherever they appear.
reporting.failure_rule: Do not tune a single failing model. Apply a protocol-wide fix to every model, increment the version, and disclose it.

version_history.recipe: LoRA A/B trained at the head learning rate of the BASIC5_ATTENTIVE_v1 block (1e-3 at batch 8 on ADE20K/NYUv2).
version_history.outcome: On ADE20K, SigLIP 2-G and DINOv3-7B diverged after warm-up (training loss 1.2-1.4 after epoch 1, rising to 2.3-3.6). Cells kept under LORA/ as a record.

version_history.change: LoRA A/B train at the BASIC5_FINETUNE_v1 learning rate of the task; the head keeps the BASIC5_ATTENTIVE_v1 rate. Applied to all six models and all tasks, and every LoRA cell was rerun.
version_history.coco: Unchanged, because the BASIC5_FINETUNE_v1 and BASIC5_FAIR_v1 COCO learning rates are equal; COCO cells keep the id B5X_LORA_LP_v1.

deviations_from_unified_code: NYUv2 frames are read upright (the basic5 loader transposed them).
One SSv2 loader (decord, bicubic) for all six models; a decode failure stops the run.
The learning-rate schedule advances per optimizer step.
